svg.title: Sending notifications during quiet hours
svg.desc: At 23:10, try sending immediately, save the notice for morning, or return DND_BLOCKED.
svg.metadata:
flowchart TB A["Send at 23:10"] --> B{"How should Reach send it?"} B --> S["Try sending immediately
ignoreDnd: true"] S --> F["Channel accepts"] --> R["Return messageId if supplied"] B --> W["Notice can wait
dnd.strategy: delay"] W --> Q["Store it and return queueId"] --> T["Try delivery from 08:00"] B --> H["Skip this send
discard / reject"] --> D["Return DND_BLOCKED"] classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px class R,Q success classDef success fill:#e4f5ee,stroke:#23775b,color:#173e34,stroke-width:1.5px
